He concealed it at home. Police later seized. So crimes: illegal possession/ manufacturing of firearms? Under Chinese law, illegal manufacturing, illegal possession, illegal storage of firearms. The act: He modified a non-firearm into a firearm, which is illegal manufacturing of firearms (非法制造枪支). Also illegal possession of firearm without license (非法持有枪支). Possibly also illegal concealment? The rules: When multiple descriptors refer to same statutory offense concerning firearms, merge them. So we have illegal manufacturing and illegal possession maybe separate offenses.
